paragraphs.label: Opening narrative
paragraphs.text: Patient presented with post-traumatic stress disorder characterized by nightmares and passive suicidal thoughts.

paragraphs.label: Psychiatric history
paragraphs.text: Patient was admitted to partial hospitalization on 2026-09-28 with a history of post-traumatic stress disorder, one prior psychiatric hospitalization, and a suicide attempt in 2018 by overdose.

paragraphs.label: Medical history
paragraphs.text: Patient has a history of asthma.

paragraphs.label: Family psychiatric history
paragraphs.text: Patient's father has a history of alcohol use disorder.

paragraphs.label: Substance use history
paragraphs.text: Patient reported consuming six beers most nights prior to admission. At the time of discharge, patient has abstained from alcohol for twenty-one days.

paragraphs.label: Program course by problem
paragraphs.text: Patient's nightmares decreased to once a week, and there were no reports of suicidal thoughts for two weeks.

paragraphs.label: Response to interventions
paragraphs.text: Patient reported improved sleep, now sleeping approximately six hours per night. Medications were adjusted to prazosin 2 milligrams at bedtime and sertraline 100 milligrams.

paragraphs.label: Condition at discharge
paragraphs.text: Patient was stable with low risk of harm.

paragraphs.label: Discharge risk assessment
paragraphs.text: Doctor assessed the patient's risk as low.

paragraphs.label: Discharge medications / follow-up / disposition
paragraphs.text: Patient will continue with medication management with Dr. Rivera in one week and therapy sessions with Ms. Patel every Tuesday. Patient was provided with the crisis line number 988.

paragraphs.label: Medication action
paragraphs.text: The patient is continuing the current medications.
